description: Live joint state saved 2026-09-22, manually jogged by the user to the closest safe radial approach of the source magnet to the beam base for the detect_blue-sourced vessel shape. Verified in-lab: at this configuration the beam can successfully travel through the vessel. Used as --magnet-exclusion-reference-joints for proper_research.planning.plan_vessel_path, defining the minimum magnet-to-tip-path exclusion radius so the offline planner does not reject configurations that are physically fine.
